```sql
WITH lines AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT pv.product_id,
           pv.id AS variant_id,
           o.id  AS order_id,
           ol.quantity,
           ol.line_total_cents
      FROM order_lines ol
      JOIN orders o            ON o.id = ol.order_id
      JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.id = ol.variant_id::uuid
     WHERE o.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
       AND o.created_at >= %(from)s
       AND o.created_at <  %(to)s
       AND o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
),
per_order AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           order_id,
           sum(quantity)::bigint    AS q,
           sum(line_total_cents)    AS r
      FROM lines
     GROUP BY product_id, order_id
),
per_product AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           count(*)          AS order_count,
           sum(q)::bigint    AS quantity,
           sum(r)            AS revenue_cents
      FROM per_order
     GROUP BY product_id
),
per_variant AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           count(*) AS variant_count
      FROM (SELECT DISTINCT product_id, variant_id FROM lines) d
     GROUP BY product_id
)
SELECT p.id,
       p.sku,
       p.name,
       p.brand,
       p.currency,
       pp.order_count,
       pp.quantity,
       pp.revenue_cents,
       pvc.variant_count
  FROM per_product pp
  JOIN per_variant pvc ON pvc.product_id = pp.product_id
  JOIN products p      ON p.id = pp.product_id
 ORDER BY quantity DESC, revenue_cents DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

De dure `Sort` op ~81k rijen met externe merge naar schijf (voor de twee `count(DISTINCT)`s) is vervangen door hash-aggregaties in stappen: eerst per (product, order), daarna per product. Het aantal varianten wordt apart bepaald via een `DISTINCT` op (product, variant). De typen van de uitvoerkolommen blijven gelijk (bigint voor quantity, numeric voor revenue), en `products` wordt pas na de aggregatie gejoind.
